_meta.description: MY MARKET RESEARCH research scoring inputs
_meta.historyFallback: Sector Growth uses relevant sector-index 1-month return when available. When sector-index history is unavailable, the median 1-month return of available stocks in that sector is used. Previous valid values are preserved if both are unavailable.

method.sectorGrowth1M: Actual 1-month relevant Nifty sector-index return; fallback is median 1-month return of available stocks in the same sector.
method.sectorStrength: Percentile rank of final sector 1-month growth across available classified sectors.
method.stockStrength1M: 1-month stock excess return versus relevant benchmark percentile
method.stockStrength3M: 3-month stock excess return versus relevant benchmark percentile
method.stockStrength6M: 6-month stock excess return versus relevant benchmark percentile
method.macroSupport: Verified evidence override when available; otherwise sector-level Macro screening heuristic
method.valueMigration: Verified company/business evidence overrides the automated price/turnover screening proxy

_meta.note: Sector Growth and Stock Growth are actual price-return percentages. Sector Strength and Stock Strength remain 0-100 percentile screening metrics. Automated Value Migration is a screening proxy and not verified business migration.
